acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from Contractor AI SEO can vary based on several factors, including the competitiveness of your market, your current online presence, and the specific strategies implemented. Generally, you can expect to see initial improvements in rankings and traffic within 3 to 6 months. Significant, sustained growth and increased lead generation typically become apparent over 6 to 12 months as AI models continuously learn and refine your optimization strategy. Consistency and ongoing refinement are key to long-term success.
